figures.finding: Kirundi is Burundi's national language and an official language, with other official languages as the law determines; no source names the language of screen work.

value.basis: constitution, not a statement on film

sources.said: Article 5 The national language is Kirundi. The official languages are Kirundi and all other languages as determined by law.

figures.finding: The Constitution fixes the capital at Bujumbura and lets the law separate the political from the economic capital; no source measuring where screen work is made was found.

value.basis: constitutional capital, not a production count

sources.said: Article 9 The capital of Burundi is fixed at Bujumbura. The law can move the capital to any other city of the Republic or it can separate the political capital from the economic capital.

sources.title: Burundi's Constitution of 2018 (Constitute Project, English translation)
sources.said: Article 5 The national language is Kirundi. The official languages are Kirundi and all other languages as determined by law. … Article 9 The capital of Burundi is fixed at Bujumbura. The law can move the capital to any other city of the Republic or it can separate the political capital from the economic capital.
